title: Pecan Knafeh
description: A Middle Eastern dessert with a twist of pecan nuts, perfect for the holiday season.
instructions: Thaw the phyllo dough according to the package instructions.
In a pan, melt the butter over low heat.
Add the pecan nuts and cook until fragrant.
Stir in the sugar, rose water, salt, and nutmeg. Cook for 2 minutes.
Layer the phyllo dough in a baking dish, brushing each layer with melted butter.
Spread the pecan mixture over the phyllo dough.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown.
In a separate pan, combine the heavy cream and maple syrup. Heat over low heat until warm.
Remove the phyllo dough from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes.
Drizzle the warm cream mixture over the phyllo dough.
